what_happened: The job to add an improvement-cycle check for OLY-10-02 and record its mechanism was rejected at the final verdict. The verifier gave one major finding and no blockers. No acceptance criteria or failed checks are listed. The finding: in improvement_cycle (crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs), the "evaluated candidate" stage uses a filter of `jobs.len() >= 2`. That is true for essentially every real proposal and checks no evaluation. So `athena status` can say the improvement cycle is shown when no candidate was ever evaluated.
cause: The new stage predicate was a proxy (the number of linked jobs) rather than a direct signal of evaluation. Nothing required the new status measure to be run over the real records, or compared with known cases, before the final verdict. A stage that is true for every real input passes tests built on hand-made fixtures. Only the verifier's independent reading exposed it. This is the same pattern as the role-need measure for OLY-9-11, from the same family of status-measure jobs: no check that a new measure can distinguish true from false on real data.
other_causes: The criteria for the mechanism likely checked that the stages exist and are shown, not that each stage can be false on real data (presence not behavior).
The producer's own tests probably used fixtures that fit the filter's assumption.
open_hypotheses: The given fields do not show whether the producer ran the check on the real records and saw the stage always true.
They do not show whether a better evaluation signal exists in the records, or whether the records record evaluation at all.
contradictions: The earlier case of this class (20261111-105017-5k6m) was about roles missed by a measure (false negatives). This one is a stage that is always true (false positives). The shared cause is a measure not checked against real records.
prevention: Add a code check that every new status or measure stage is run over the real records and must give both outcomes: it must not be true for all items or false for all items, unless a stated reason is recorded. It must also be compared with known cases. The verifier's evidence for such a job must include that run. No gate is named, because every gate's disagreements are 0.
proposed_request: Fix the improvement-cycle check for OLY-10-02 so that its "evaluated candidate" stage reflects a real evaluation. In crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs, fn improvement_cycle, the candidate filter `jobs.len() >= 2` is true for almost every real proposal. Replace it with a signal from the records that shows an evaluation actually happened for that candidate (for example, a recorded evaluation result), and state in the code which record field is used. Acceptance: (1) Run improvement_cycle over the real introspection records and show in the job report the count of proposals marked evaluated and the count not marked. Both must be reasoned from the records, and the stage must not be true for every proposal. (2) A test with fixtures built from real record shapes shows a proposal with no evaluation is not counted as evaluated, and one with an evaluation is. (3) `athena status` says the improvement cycle is shown only when a candidate was actually evaluated. (4) Add the CHANGELOG.md entry. (5) cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings and cargo test all pass, and any test that reads athena status output still passes. Behavior evidence must cite the commands the producer ran.
